subject.title: Feature Request: Per-agent context/workspace on model fallback

question: Should OpenClaw fallback attempts switch to another configured agent/workspace, apply a model-specific context profile, or remain model-only with narrower fallback notice/re-injection improvements?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but the permanent public API affects config schema, session identity, agentDir/workspace ownership, auth routing, skills snapshots, and upgrade behavior, so automation should not choose the product shape.

options.title: Choose fallback context profiles
options.body: Define a first-class model or fallback context profile that can control bootstrap budgets/files, skills visibility, and context without changing agent identity by default.

options.title: Add explicit fallback agent/workspace
options.body: Allow fallback attempts to select another configured agent or workspace, but require explicit session, auth, state, and migration semantics before implementation.

options.title: Defer to narrower fixes
options.body: Leave model fallback selection unchanged for now and solve notification, re-injection, model-key, or auth-propagation subproblems in their own threads.

recommendation.title: Choose fallback context profiles
recommendation.body: Define a first-class model or fallback context profile that can control bootstrap budgets/files, skills visibility, and context without changing agent identity by default.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already posted the design-oriented keep-open review and the reachable history points to adjacent fallback/config ownership.
